stories.headline: MSU stuns Michigan 15-6 to bring Paul Bunyan home
stories.summary: Liam Boyd kicked five field goals and the Spartan defense forced four turnovers with five sacks at the Big House, giving MSU (3-6, 1-5 Big Ten) its first rivalry win since 2021 and snapping a six-game skid; Washington visits East Lansing Saturday at 4:15 p.m. on BTN.

stories.headline: Gunman kills six in Krakow's Main Square
stories.summary: A gunman fired at random people as he drove into Krakow's main tourist square, killing six and wounding 15 before police shot and wounded him; authorities say he holds ultranationalist views, and three more bodies were later found at his home, per the BBC.

stories.headline: Israel's president taps Eisenkot, not Netanyahu, to form a government
stories.summary: With neither bloc holding a majority after last week's election, President Herzog asked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to try to form a new government after Israel's main parties recommended him.

stories.headline: Colorado voters swap the flat income tax for a graduated system
stories.summary: Voters passed Amendment 87, replacing Colorado's flat income tax with graduated rates, and rejected Proposition 136, which would have capped everyone's rate at the current 4.4%.

breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 501 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Nov. 6 close (mimics MMFI). Breadth slipped slightly even as the indexes bounced, since Friday's gains were concentrated in chip stocks. Markets were closed Saturday, so this carries over the Nov. 6 reading.

fear_greed.commentary: Markets were closed Saturday, so Fear & Greed still reads 22 from Friday's close, in extreme fear and well below 26 a week ago and 47 a month ago.

markets.summary: Markets were closed Saturday, so the table and breadth carry over Friday's close: the S&P 500 finished at 7,376.86 (down 2.7% on the week), the Nasdaq at 24,579.43 after its fourth straight weekly loss and still in correction, and the Dow at 51,285.73. Tech led Friday's partial bounce as chip stocks recovered, while small caps edged up but stayed below their 40-week average. Rates stayed firm after the strong October jobs report, with traders leaning toward a December Fed hike, which puts Tuesday's October CPI report squarely in focus. Gold and silver slipped Friday but both gained more than 4% on the week.

stories.headline: Cameco renews US$1 billion at-the-market share program
stories.summary: Cameco renewed its at-the-market equity program, letting it sell up to US$1 billion of new shares at its discretion, which could dilute existing holders if used.

stories.headline: Cameco hits a new 52-week low
stories.summary: Cameco touched a 12-month low this week as Scotiabank trimmed its earnings forecasts, though Zacks upgraded the stock to hold and options traders bought calls heavily on Friday.

headlines.headline: Strategists warn the AI sell-off may not be over
headlines.summary: After the Dow's 1,800-point plunge Thursday and a partial Friday rebound, strategists told CNBC they expect more selling before a durable bottom, watching for the VIX to top 30 as a sign of capitulation.

headlines.headline: October CPI and CoreWeave, Cisco earnings headline the week ahead
headlines.summary: The October consumer price index lands Tuesday at 8:30 a.m. ET with producer prices Friday, while CoreWeave reports Tuesday and Cisco and Applied Materials report Thursday.

stories.headline: U.S. homelessness posts its biggest drop in over a decade
stories.summary: Homelessness fell after years of record highs but still stands near 700,000 people; the Trump administration and advocacy groups credit different causes.

stories.headline: US offers $20 million reward for information on Iran's nuclear program
stories.summary: The reward comes as President Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewed strikes on Iran's nuclear facilities.

stories.headline: No. 5 MSU women's soccer meets Michigan in Sunday's Big Ten semifinal
stories.summary: Fourth-seeded Michigan State (14-3-2) faces eighth-seeded Michigan (8-5-5) at 2 p.m. ET Sunday at Energizer Park in St. Louis, a rematch after the Wolverines won 3-1 in East Lansing on Sept. 20. Bella Najera's 96th-minute goal lifted the Spartans past Washington 3-2 in Thursday's quarterfinals.

stories.headline: MSU men's soccer opens Big Ten Tournament against Maryland on Sunday
stories.summary: Fourth-seeded Michigan State (10-4-3) faces fifth-seeded Maryland at 1 p.m. Sunday at Bill Armstrong Stadium in Bloomington, looking to snap a two-game skid after losses to Rutgers and No. 4 Indiana. The winner plays host Indiana in Wednesday's semifinals.

stories.headline: Dozens Come To Faith After Church Purchases Golf Simulator
stories.summary: In this Babylon Bee satire, an Oklahoma church's new golf simulator proves a more effective evangelism tool than anything tried before.

stories.headline: Promises Kept: Democrats Deliver On Affordability By Making Stocks Way Cheaper
stories.summary: The Bee jokes that Democrats have already met their affordability pledge, since stock prices got much cheaper within days of the midterms.

weather.summary: Storms fed by Gulf moisture bring heavy rain to south-central and south Texas on Sunday, with a Slight Risk of excessive rainfall and scattered flash flooding, lingering into Monday. Pacific systems keep showers, mountain snow and gusty coastal winds coming to the Northwest, while most of the country stays dry and 5 to 15 degrees above average under high pressure, with one more frosty morning Sunday from the Mid-South to the Ohio and Tennessee Valleys.
